title: p4-constraints
purpose: Storage probe I2/I3: introspection must report a column's type, nullability and default, and must distinguish a UNIQUE index from a plain one. REG-129 was exactly that bug on one engine; a hand-written CREATE TABLE would test the test's SQL rather than NPDev's realized schema.
walkthrough: A FIXTURE, not a demo -- it serves conformance vector I2/I3 and nothing else.
Built by the storage conformance Tier C tests; not intended to be run by hand.
expectedOutcomes: Introspection reports email as NOT NULL and nickname as NULLABLE.
The unique constraint on email is reported unique; ix_account_region is reported NOT unique.
